scenes.name: ONE ARC
lines: Ten parts, thirty-nine chapters. It looks like a pile of topics, but it is one walk.
十部、三十九章，看上去是一堆题目，其实是同一段路。
Point to line, line to area, area to sphere, then a step outside. Later parts turn back toward the one who looks.
从点到线，从线到面，从面到球，再走出球外；后面几部转回来，看那个正在看的人。
Let's walk it once, and pick up one checked result at every stop.
我们把这段路走一遍，每一站只捡一条检验过的结论。

scenes.name: PARTS I TO V
lines: One: compare two arrows directly. The Born weight is the overlap squared; at sixty degrees, one quarter.
第一部：两支箭头直接比。玻恩权重是重叠的平方：夹角 60°，就是四分之一。
Two: two arrows hold a line and an area. Nine plus thirty-six is forty-five, the squared lengths multiplied.
第二部：两支箭头之间有一条线和一块面积。9 + 36 = 45，正是长度平方之积。
Three: two tilted axes are enough. Any turn of space is a finite chain of turns about those two.
第三部：两根不共线的轴就够了。空间的任何转动，都是绕这两根轴的有限串转动。
Four: two qubits, four fixed settings. No state scores above two root two, and the Bell state hits it.
第四部：两个量子比特，四个固定设置。没有哪个态超过 2√2，贝尔态恰好达到。
Five: spacetime. A quadratic form that vanishes on every light ray is the interval, times one number.
第五部：时空。一个在每条光线上都为零的二次型，就是时空间隔乘上一个数。

scenes.name: PARTS VI TO X
lines: Six: a map fed its own output. One plus one over x has one positive fixed point, the golden ratio.
第六部：把输出喂回给自己。x ↦ 1 + 1/x 在正数里只有一个不动点：黄金比。
Seven: no referee. Two unit records overlap by exactly one precisely when they are the same record.
第七部：没有裁判。两条单位记录的重叠恰好等于 1，当且仅当它们是同一条记录。
Eight: tiny arcs. Six terms of the series for e to the i miss it by about one thousandth.
第八部：极小圆弧。eⁱ 的级数取前六项，离 eⁱ 只差约千分之一。
Nine: a table that lists itself. A row that copies the twisted diagonal forces a fixed point.
第九部：一张列出自己的表。哪一行抄下了扭过的对角线，哪里就逼出一个不动点。
Ten: under squaring, one full turn below lifts to a half turn above. You arrive at minus one.
第十部：在平方映射下，下面转满一圈，上面只转半圈：你停在 −1。

scenes.name: WHERE IT STOPS
lines: Why do we expect a journey to need a grand finale? Shrinking needs none.
我们凭什么以为一段路非要有个宏大的结局？只会缩小的东西，不需要。
Six marbles in a bag. Each round, every marble numbered above the count leaves. Nothing comes back.
袋里六颗弹珠。每一轮，编号大于袋中颗数的弹珠离开，没有一颗回来。
Six, four, three, three. Two changes, then it is still from round two on.
6、4、3、3。改了两次，从第二轮起就不再变。
Lean checks the general case: on a finite set, a delete-only update stops within as many steps as it started with.
Lean 检验一般情形：有限集合上只删不添，至多走初始个数那么多步就停下。
Take only from a finite bag, and it must come to rest.
有限的袋子只拿不放，终将停下。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: The arc is a way to read the book, not a theorem. Lean checks each stop, not the road.
这条弧是读这本书的一种方式，不是定理。Lean 检验的是每一站，不是这条路。
Coming to rest is not emptying, and it is not the cosine fixed point; that uses Banach's principle, a literature result.
停下不等于清空，也不是余弦不动点；后者要用巴拿赫压缩原理，是文献结果。
And P versus NP, and three-dimensional Navier–Stokes smoothness, stay open.
而 P 与 NP、三维纳维—斯托克斯方程的光滑性，仍是开放问题。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, the coda.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 终章
